message.content: The M249 features a distinct FDE tan polymer for the ammo box and stock, which contrasts with the darker, matte black metal of the receiver and barrel assembly. The model's edges appear mostly flat-shaded and blocky, lacking detailed chamfering or complex machined bevels typical of higher-fidelity renders. There are no obvious rendering glitches like missing textures or z-fighting, though the weapon model has a simplified, slightly low-poly aesthetic.
